metadata.description: 👾 utopia-zero by UtopiaSoftware - a guided zero-to-app wizard for non-programmers: staged idea-to-handover flow, web-first environment setup, multi-session state, and opt-out experiment analytics logged into the project repo.

plugins.name: utopia-zero
plugins.description: 👾 Guide a complete non-programmer (or a hurried pro) from an idea to a developable Flutter POC/MVP. Staged wizard: tutorial → idea & design interview → web-first environment setup → app skeleton → feature loop → optional devices → handover for professional developers. Multi-session state in zero/STATE.md, GitHub-issue escalation, opt-out experiment analytics in the project repo, and orchestration of the utopia-flutter-skills plugins (hooks, ai-arch, dart-lsp, cms, reviews).
